ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $ \triangle ABC$, points D and E are located on sides $ AB$ and $ AC$ respectively, and $ DE\parallel BC$. If $ AD=2\,cm$, $ AB=6\,cm$, and $ AE=1.5\,cm$, what is the length of $ EC$ in $cm$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $DE\parallel BC$,\\
it follows that $\frac{AD}{AB}=\frac{AE}{AC}=\frac{2}{6}=\frac{1}{3}$,\\
thus $\frac{1.5}{AC}=\frac{1}{3}$,\\
solving this gives: $AC=4.5\text{cm}$,\\
therefore $EC=AC-AE=4.5-1.5=\boxed{3}\text{cm}$.
